Workspace Settings

Every task stores its start as "minutes after the base date". The base date is the zero point of that ruler.

Changing it re-anchors every task so each keeps its calendar date. Undo history is cleared, so take a JSON backup first if you are unsure.

Someday / Maybe — items with no date

You never need a fake far-future date. A Someday item is parked in the Inbox: it has no deadline, never turns overdue, and stays off the timeline and calendar until you give it a date.

In the task dialogTick “💭 Someday / no date” or press “💭 No date”
Leave the date empty and press CreateSaved as Someday automatically
Quick Add: add #someday (or #inbox) to a lineIts sub-items are Someday too
Right-click → Move to SomedayWorks on a task or a whole project
Right-click → Give it a date…Promote it to the schedule
Filter chip “Inbox”See everything parked

The Companion window

The Companion is a second window with a live dashboard, a Life Balance view, a one-page Project Builder and the full manual with working deep links back to this planner. Both stay in sync.
